Name: Piltover Valley
Author: sabrinapemberton
Description:
[size=4][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/7G6GZEC.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center][youtube]D0LqpZX2gig[/youtube][/center]

based on [color=#ff0000]Netflix[/color]'s breakout animation hit, [i][color=#e69138]Arcane[/color][/i], based on Riot's breakout MOBA hit, [i][color=#e69138]League of Legends[/color][/i], today we proudly present [i]Piltover Valley[/i], the [i]Arcane[/i]-themed rewrite and reskin of [i]Stardew Valley[/i].

Every single vanilla villager from Pelican Town, Calico Desert, and Ginger Island have had their sprites and portraits entirely revised, as well as all dialog lines adapted or rewritten and expanded upon to congrue with their new Arcane-themed personalities!

Meet the cast:
[/size]

[list]
[*][b][size=3]Caitlyn[/size][/b] [size=2](Abigail)[/size]
[*][b][size=3]Vi[/size][/b] [size=2](Sebastian)[/size]

[*][size=3][b]Elora[/b] [/size][size=2](Emily)[/size]
[*][b][size=3]Margot[/size][/b] [size=2](Leah)[/size]
[/list][i]Bachelors[/i]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Jayce[/size][/b] [size=2](Alex)[/size]
[*][b][size=3]Viktor[/size][/b] [size=2](Harvey)[/size]

[*][b][size=3]Finn[/size][/b] [size=2](Elliot)[/size]
[/list]
[i]also featuring[/i] [size=3]Vander, Benzo, Silco, Sevika, Cassandra, Tobias, Ximena, Heimerdinger, Hoskel, Grayson, Huck, Jericho, Singed, Smeech, Renni, Chross, Lock, Ren, and the gimp yordle, with special guest stars Ryze, Ezreal, Dr. Mundo, Ziggs, Corina Veraza, Seraphine, and Z.A.C.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KVkVoT1.png[/img]


[/size][color=#93c47d]What to expect:[/color]
[size=3]- Dozens of brand new, lovingly crafted character portraits
[/size][size=3]- Thousands of adapted or expanded dialog lines, and hundreds of brand new dialog lines, especially around the marriage candidates, and especially the more you get to know them
- More-robust relationships between the villagers, rewarding the farmer for spending continued time with them.
[/size][size=3]- Full compatibility with functionality-expanding mods, such as tools, UI enhancements, the mobile phone mod, and any mods that add new fish, forage, machines, player character fashion, et cetera. [i]Piltover Valley[/i] does not change nor conflict with any game systems, nor anything to do with the farmer.[/size]

[color=#e06666]What [b]not[/b] to expect:[/color]
[size=3]- No expected compatibility with other dialog-expanding mods, town-expanding mods, portrait mods, or similar character enhancements you can find. Too much of the text here and characterization is rewritten that it will inevitably conflict.[/size]
[size=3]- No brand new heart events. These are a ton of work and relatively difficult to test, which gives them a smaller return on investment. Hopefully the wealth of new chat lines compensates for this ♥[/size]
[size=3]- Nothing fundamentally new. This is still a straight-up Stardew Valley experience at the end of the day :)[/size]



[size=4][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/size]
[size=3]- Make sure you have ContentPatcher is already installed[/size]
[size=3]- Drag the [/size][font=Courier New][color=#d8d8d8][CP] Piltover Valley[/color][/font][size=3] folder into your [/size][font=Courier New][color=#d8d8d8]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color] [/font][font=Arial]folder.
[/font][size=3]- Run the game from the StardewModdingAPI.exe

[size=4][u]UNINSTALLATION[/u][/size]
[size=3]- [/size][size=3]Delete the [/size][font=Courier New][color=#d8d8d8][CP] Piltover Valley[/color] [/font][size=3]folder from your [/size][font=Courier New][color=#d8d8d8]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color] [/font][font=Arial]folder.
[/font][/size]
[size=3][i]Piltover Valley[/i] does not alter your save data in any way, so it can be used with any existing save file, or removed from any save file without any adverse effects.[/size]
